usageNotes: Use this endpoint to register a new PVE cluster or PBS instance as a managed remote in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. The caller must hold the Resource.Modify privilege. Supply a pre-created API token via `authid` and `token`, or let PDM create one automatically by providing the `create-token` param — the latter requires the authid credentials to have token-creation rights on the remote.

examples.summary: Register a Proxmox VE cluster as a PDM remote using an existing API token

tips: The `id` field becomes the stable reference key for this remote across all PDM operations — choose a short, descriptive slug (e.g., 'hetzner-pve', 'ovh-pbs') since it cannot be changed after creation.
Each entry in `nodes` should be a host:port pair matching the API port of the target cluster node (8006 for PVE, 8007 for PBS).

If using `create-token`, PDM will call back to the remote to provision the token; the remote must be reachable at registration time and the authid credentials must have the Sys.Audit + User.Modify privileges on the remote.
Returns null on success (HTTP 200); absence of an error is the confirmation. Use get_remotes_remote to verify the entry was stored.
